verdict.rationale: Veriff documents a Public API with concrete endpoints: POST /v1/sessions to start verification sessions and GET /v1/sessions/{id}/decision to poll decisions. It also documents HMAC-signed authentication, a Postman collection, and test integrations, so a programmatic or agentic consumer can drive verification end to end. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
